perplexity.description:
Cleft’s album BOSH!, released on 10 February 2014 via Mega Face Records, is the band’s second and final studio album, marking the culmination of their distinctive instrumental rock sound. Characterized by intricate guitar work, dynamic rhythms, and a blend of post-rock and math rock influences, BOSH! showcases Cleft’s ability to craft complex, energetic compositions without relying on vocals. The album’s tracks, such as “12 Second Panda” and “Alec Baldwin’s Hair,” highlight the band’s penchant for quirky titles and tightly structured, rhythmically adventurous music.

Within Cleft’s discography, BOSH! stands as their definitive statement, following their debut and preceding their eventual disbandment. The album was well-received by fans and critics for its technical proficiency and creative energy, with the band themselves describing it as “slightly better than a kick in the face.” While it did not achieve mainstream commercial success, BOSH! solidified Cleft’s reputation in the UK’s underground rock scene and remains a respected entry in the math rock and post-rock genres.
